# Tradly Market

> Tradly Market is a Nairobi-based food-service marketplace for fresh vegetables, fruit, dairy, rice and pantry staples. One supplier, one invoice, same-day dispatch across Kenyan kitchens.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Browse featured produce, today's prices, and frequent reorders.
- [Search](/search): Search the full catalog by name, category, or keyword.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable list of all indexable product and category pages.
